mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce valbenazine exposure, while both drugs carry CNS depression risk and valbenazine may inhibit metabolism of eslicarbazepine's active metabolite.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of valbenazine; consider dose adjustment or alternative antiepileptic if tardive dyskinesia control is inadequate; counsel on additive CNS effects.
